 Dated this the 3rd day of October, 2024
 Order 
This Criminal Miscellaneous case is filed with following prayers :
"...pass an order quashing Annexure A complaint and all its further proceedings in CC No.602/2018 on the file of the Addl. Chief Judl. Magistrate Court (Economic Offences), Ernakulam by allowing the above Crl.M.C." [sic]
2. The counsel for the 1st respondent submitted that the 1st respondent is ready to withdraw the complaint and because of the stay in this case, the learned Magistrate is not permitting the same. If that is the case, I think this Criminal Miscellaneous case can be closed and the 1 st respondent can file appropriate application before the trial court under Sec.257 Cr.P.C. for withdrawing the complaint. 
Therefore, this Criminal Miscellaneous case is closed. 
2024 : KER:73565 Registry will forward a copy of this order to the trial court forthwith. 
Sd/-
